newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept energy investment up 19 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept energy investment up 19 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's investment in its energy sector totalled 159.5 billion yuan ($19.2 billion) in January to September, a rise of 19 percent compared with the year-ago period, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
Investment in the coal industry was 14.25 billion yuan in the first nine months, up 16.1 percent from the same period a year ago, Xinhua quoted figures from the State Statistical Bureau as showing.
Investment in the petroleum sector was up 4.1 percent in the period to 48.69 billion yuan, the agency said.
China sunk 96.6 billion yuan into power generation in the period, a rise of 28.8 percent, it said.
